title: Alperin–McKay Conjecture
exact_target: Does each finite-group block contain exactly as many height-zero ordinary characters as its Brauer correspondent in the normalizer of a defect group?

sources.citation: Lucas Ruhstorfer, Quasi-isolated blocks and the Alperin–McKay conjecture, introduction; height-zero convention from The Alperin–McKay conjecture for the prime2, introduction.
